edit.description: TableReservationEditDialog: same form with a Table select first and a Save Changes button (h-840, clamped by max-h-90vh).

complete.description: TableReservationCompleteDialog (max-w-xl): blue summary card with a Confirmed badge and a blue Complete button.

complete-loading.description: Completion in progress: both buttons disabled.
